From the menu

A few of the dishes people drive across town for. Tap any one to order it.

  • Weekday Lunch ThaliA full plate of small dishes, rice, bread and dessert. Monday to Friday lunch.
  • Masala DosaCrisp rice-and-lentil crepe around spiced potato, with chutneys and sambar.
  • Davangere Benne DosaThe buttery, soft-crisp dosa from Karnataka.
  • Sambar IdliSteamed idlis soaked in hot sambar.
  • Plain PesarattuAndhra-style green moong dal dosa.
  • Ghee Ven PongalRice and moong dal cooked soft with ghee, pepper and cumin.
  • Guntur Ghee Kaaram Thatte IdlyPlate-sized idli, ghee and fiery Guntur podi.
  • Nellore Ghee Kaaram Thatte IdlyThe Nellore take on thatte idli, with its own spice blend.
  • Ghee Kaaram Fried Button IdlyBite-sized idlis, fried and tossed in ghee and podi.
  • Mix Veg UthappamA thick, soft rice pancake topped with vegetables.
See the full menu

From the kitchen

200 dishes. One tradition.

From Nellore karam masala dosa to the Pelli Bhojanam thali, every dish on the menu comes from the regional cooking of South India. All of it vegetarian, none of it watered down.

In 2024 The New York Times came to Irving and put us on its list of America's 50 best restaurants, one of only a handful of vegetarian restaurants in the country to earn that recognition.

What meals do you serve?

We serve breakfast, lunch and dinner. Breakfast hours vary by location, so check your location's hours before you head over.

Do you offer delivery or takeout?

Yes, both. Takeout and delivery are available when you order online.

Do you take reservations?

Yes, at every location. Pick a location to book a table.

What areas do you serve?

Irving, Coppell, Carrollton, Farmers Branch, Frisco, Plano, The Colony, McKinney, Allen, Katy, Cinco Ranch, Warrenville, Naperville, Aurora, Wheaton, Lisle, Winfield, Eola, Warrenhurst, Johnsue.

Anything else?

We're a family-friendly restaurant, and the menu has a kids' section.
